Item

Source: R/tier1-item.R
shad_item.Rd

A flexible list-row primitive: media, title/description, and actions in one flex row. Group with shad_item_group() and divide with shad_item_separator(). Render as a link with href for a clickable row.

Usage

shad_item(
  title,
  description = NULL,
  media = NULL,
  actions = NULL,
  variant = c("default", "outline", "muted"),
  size = c("default", "sm", "xs"),
  media_variant = NULL,
  header = NULL,
  footer = NULL,
  href = NULL,
  class = NULL,
  ...
)

shad_item_group(..., role = "list", class = NULL)

shad_item_separator()

Arguments

title

The item's title (or any content for the title slot).

description

Optional secondary text (clamped to two lines).

media

Optional shad_icon() name or a tag (icon, image, avatar).

actions

Optional trailing controls (buttons, a switch, a chevron).

variant

One of "default" (transparent), "outline", "muted".

size

One of "default", "sm", "xs".

media_variant

"icon" (bordered muted tile) or "image" (rounded thumb). Ignored when media is NULL or free-form (e.g. an avatar).

header

Optional full-width top row.

footer

Optional full-width bottom row.

href

Optional URL; renders the row as <a class="shad-item">.

class

Extra CSS classes.

...

Extra attributes on the root.

role

ARIA role for the group container (default "list"); items keep role="listitem".

Value

An item tag.

See also

Other shadshiny tier-1 components: shad_alert(), shad_aspect_ratio(), shad_avatar(), shad_badge(), shad_breadcrumb(), shad_button(), shad_button_group(), shad_card(), shad_code_block(), shad_empty(), shad_kbd_group(), shad_label(), shad_progress(), shad_scroll_fade(), shad_separator(), shad_shimmer(), shad_skeleton(), shad_spinner(), shad_table(), shad_typography

Examples

shad_item("Nightly backup", description = "Runs every day at 02:00 UTC.",
          media = "clock", variant = "outline",
          actions = shad_button("Configure", variant = "outline", size = "sm"))
#> <div class="shad-item shad-item--outline">
#>   <div class="shad-item__media shad-item__media--icon" aria-hidden="true">
#>     <svg class="shad-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><polyline points="12 6 12 12 16 14"/></svg>
#>   </div>
#>   <div class="shad-item__content">
#>     <div class="shad-item__title">Nightly backup</div>
#>     <div class="shad-item__description">Runs every day at 02:00 UTC.</div>
#>   </div>
#>   <div class="shad-item__actions">
#>     <button type="button" class="shad-btn shad-btn--outline shad-btn--sm">Configure</button>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
